info.title: ChatFlows REST API
info.description:
ChatFlows REST API (v1).

**Base URL:** `https://app.chatflows.io/api/v1` — also shown, with a copy button, on your **Developer API Keys** page.

**Auth:** every authenticated request sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, where the token is created under **Setup → Developer API Keys** in your dashboard.

**What a token can see:** a token belongs to ONE workspace — your store's. Every endpoint returns only that workspace's data, and `/api/v1/account` describes your own workspace. A token created before tokens were tied to a workspace is refused with `401 token_not_scoped`; create a new one to replace it.

**Scopes:** each endpoint's description lists the token ability it requires. Create your token with the matching scopes.

**Pagination:** list endpoints return `{ data, links: { next, prev }, meta }`. Large/append-only collections (contacts, group members, webhooks) use opaque cursor pagination — follow `links.next` until it is `null`. `per_page` is clamped to 5–100.

**Async sends:** message and OTP sends return `202` and are processed on the queue.

**Error envelope:**
```json
{ "message": "...", "error_code": "...", "status": 4xx }
```

**Modules:** Auth/Account · Channels · Contacts · Statuses · Sources · Groups · Labels · Templates · Messages · Conversations · OTP.

metadata.description: Sends a WhatsApp message to a customer: an approved template, or a text reply.

x-mint.content:
Set `type` to choose what you send:

| `type` | Also send | When you can use it |
|---|---|---|
| `template` | `template_id`, and `template_data` if the template has variables | Any time |
| `text` | `body` | Only within 24 hours of the customer's last message to you |

The message is sent in the background. You get its `id` straight away. Use Get Message to see if it was delivered.

For example, to send to customer `5`, use `/api/v1/contacts/5/messages`.

metadata.description: Returns one message and its delivery status.

x-mint.content:
The `status` shows where your message is:

| `status` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pending` / `queued` | Waiting to be sent. |
| `sent` | Sent to WhatsApp. |
| `delivered` | Reached the customer's phone. |
| `read` | The customer opened it. |
| `failed` | Not sent. `error_message` tells you why. |

metadata.description: Sends a one-time code to your customer's WhatsApp to confirm their phone number.

x-mint.content:
The template you use must be approved and in the Authentication category.

The response includes a `reference`. Save it, because you need it to verify, resend or cancel the code.

Each code works for 10 minutes. To change this, set `expiry_minutes` to a value from 1 to 60.

You can send up to 5 codes per hour and 20 codes per day to the same phone number.
